provenIntegrationDeviations: Generic replacement prompt differed from the tuned baseline.
Four-field schema replaced the original five fields and requested a dedicated spatial relationship array.
384-token bound and explicit seed42 differed from baseline900/no explicit seed.
768px JPEG85 twice differed from original1536cap/JPEG90 once.
Reference language and text-integrity checks were omitted.
repairedWithEvidence: Exact baseline prompt/schema/settings restored and source hashes/AST parity tests passed.
Lossless browser PNG followed by one service JPEG90 avoids repeated lossy encoding; metadata/orientation/alpha/full-frame tests passed.
Reference text checks now reject duplicate uncertainties without deleting/repairing claims.
notProven: That any one deviation caused the previous semantic failure.
That copying the prompt/configuration alone cures hallucinations.
That native renderer/tokenization is equivalent to installed Ollama.
That all principal spatial claims are grounded after restoration.
rootCauseAssessment.remainingObservedDefect: C-dog contains a major unsupported head-on-pillow relation despite valid JSON and reference text acceptance.

qualification.reason: Diagnostic reuse, residual unsupported relation/activity claims, provider/template differences and no independent human review. Minimum held-out grounding gates cannot be certified from these records.

comparisonLimitations: B-vs-C changes prompt, schema, token budget, seed policy and preprocessing together; it cannot identify a single cause.
B-vs-D holds old pixels/provider fixed but changes prompt/schema/generation as a bundle; it still cannot attribute change to prompt alone.

C-vs-D nominally holds native prompt/schema/options fixed while changing the complete pixel representation. Single sequential samples, different cached prefix counts and no replicated resets prevent a universal resolution/compression conclusion.
A-vs-C shares exact source and prepared input SHA but retains provider/renderer/template/device/runtime differences.
These two images were reused for diagnosis and are not independent held-out qualification.
